data PsInstruction Source #

Pseudo-instructions used during compilation/assembly.

@details PsInstruction is an intermediate representation used by the compiler to express labels and label-referencing operations before a dedicated assembly pass resolves textual labels to concrete instruction offsets. Many constructors here resolve to a 'Real Instruction' when labels are resolved in the assembly pass.

@return N/A (this documents the type)
